en-US.name: Metanorma
en-US.releaseNotes:
metanorma v1.17.0-4 (tebako v2 assembly)
Single-executable Metanorma assembled with the tebako v2 pipeline
(fetch → assemble → validate → publish). Nothing compiles on your
machine: the package carries the metanorma/OpenJDK payload
slices plus the xml2rfc spawned payload with its python runtime
(spec 32), and resolves the tebako Ruby runtime on first run.
- metanorma payload: 1.17.0 (release 1.17.0-6)
- OpenJDK slice: v2.8.50
- xml2rfc slice (spawned payload, spec 32): 3.34.2-1, dispatched on its bundled python runtime
- runtime: tebako ruby 4.0.7 (runtime 0.17.1), resolved via tebako toolchain v2.8.68
First run
The package is LEAN: on first run it downloads the Ruby runtime pair
(interpreter + env image, sha256-verified) into ~/.tebako and caches
it machine-wide; later runs start immediately.
───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────────────────
Platform                   │Asset
───────────────────────────┼────────────────────────────────────────
macOS (Apple Silicon)      │metanorma-darwin-arm64.tgz
───────────────────────────┼────────────────────────────────────────
macOS (Intel)              │metanorma-darwin-x86_64.tgz
───────────────────────────┼────────────────────────────────────────
Linux (x86_64)             │metanorma-linux-x86_64.tgz
───────────────────────────┼────────────────────────────────────────
Linux (arm64)              │metanorma-linux-arm64.tgz
───────────────────────────┼────────────────────────────────────────
Linux (x86_64, Alpine/musl)│metanorma-linux-musl-x86_64.tgz
───────────────────────────┼────────────────────────────────────────
Linux (arm64, Alpine/musl) │metanorma-linux-musl-arm64.tgz
───────────────────────────┼────────────────────────────────────────
Windows (x86_64)           │metanorma-windows-x86_64.exe (also .zip)
───────────────────────────┴────────────────────────────────────────
System installers (macOS)
Signed + notarized pkg installers (spec 16 §7: the tebako tool
set on PATH, the metanorma payload seeded into the machine-wide
home and its runtime warmed at install time — first run needs no
downloads). Built and install-rehearsed by the installer-pkg
legs; they attach to this release shortly after it exists.
───────────────────────────────┬───────────────────────────────────────
Platform                       │Asset
───────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────
macOS installer (Apple Silicon)│metanorma-setup-1.17.0-macos-arm64.pkg
───────────────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────
macOS installer (Intel)        │metanorma-setup-1.17.0-macos-x86_64.pkg
───────────────────────────────┴───────────────────────────────────────
System installers (Windows)
Azure-signed MSI installer (spec 16 §7: the tebako tool set and
the metanorma shim on the system PATH, the metanorma payload
seeded into the machine-wide home and its runtime warmed at
install time — first run needs no downloads). Per-machine install
under Program Files (the system PATH gains the tools); per-user
data stays per-user in ~/.tebako. Built and install-rehearsed by
the installer-msi leg; it attaches to this release shortly after
it exists.
──────────────────────────┬─────────────────────────────────────────
Platform                  │Asset
──────────────────────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────
Windows installer (x86_64)│metanorma-setup-1.17.0-windows-ucrt64.msi
──────────────────────────┴─────────────────────────────────────────
